# manifold_device_groups (Data Source)

Lists the custom endpoint groups admins have defined for the device fleet. Needs the `read:fleet` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "manifold_device_groups" "all" {}

locals {
  example_group_id = one([for g in data.manifold_device_groups.all.groups : g.id if g.name == "Example group"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Every custom group, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Free-text description; empty when unset.
- `id` (String) The group's identifier, a UUID.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of devices currently in the group.
- `name` (String) The group's name, unique across the fleet.
